comment: Read by scripts/audit-check.mjs, keyed by ghsa and package. Each path comes from `npm explain`; the check does not verify it.

exceptions.reason: Build tool: @expo/cli runs on the developer machine and in CI, zod is absent from the iOS and Android bundle source maps (29/10). @expo/cli 57 requires zod ^3.25.76; the fix (4.6.6) needs another Expo SDK.

Shipped in the app: it decodes scanandstock:// links and route parameters, so a malformed link can slow the app down (denial of service, no data exposed). expo-router 57 has no fixed version; kept by decision of 2026-10-26 until the move to SDK 58.
